title: Portrait settings
description: A portrait_settings*.bin file: the portraits (campaign portholes and the character details window) of art sets.

version.description: File format version: 4 in WARHAMMER III, 1 in Attila, Thrones of Britannia and WARHAMMER I/II.

id.description: Art set key (campaign_character_art_sets_tables) these portraits are for.

camera_settings_head.description: Camera of the porthole portrait (campaign, bottom left).

camera_settings_body.description: Camera of the full body shown in the character details window. Only characters need one; null for units.

variants.description: Portrait images, one per variant of the art set.

z.description: Distance from the character to the camera.

yaw.description: Sideways rotation of the camera, in degrees.

pitch.description: Vertical rotation of the camera, in degrees. The camera levels itself beyond 90/-90.

skeleton_node.description: Skeleton node the camera focuses on; positions and rotations are relative to it. Empty for none.

filename.description: Variant name: the filename column of variants_tables.

file_diffuse.description: Pack path of the portrait image, e.g. ui/portraits/portholes/.../x_0.png.

file_mask_1.description: Pack path of a mask image (optional).

file_mask_2.description: Pack path of a mask image (optional).

file_mask_3.description: Pack path of a mask image (optional).
